stories.title: Giva raises $100 million to expand retail network
stories.summary: Fine jewellery brand Giva has raised over $100 million in a funding round led by Multiples Alternate Asset Management. The company plans to use the capital to strengthen manufacturing and scale its omnichannel operations, with a goal of reaching over 1,000 outlets in the coming years.

stories.title: AltM raises $10.3 million in Series A funding
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup AltM has raised $10.3 million in a Series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The Bengaluru-based company will use the funds to expand manufacturing capacity, support customer qualification programmes, and grow its engineering and commercial teams.

stories.title: EloElo Group raises $80 million in Series C
stories.summary: Consumer AI and entertainment company EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. The company will use the capital to fund original content and strengthen its agentic AI creative suite, Dolphin AI.

stories.title: Peppermint Robotics raises Rs 100 crore
stories.summary: Pune and Austin-based Peppermint Robotics has raised Rs 100 crore in a pre-Series B round led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners. The startup, which builds autonomous cleaning robots, plans to use the funding to support its operations across nine countries.

stories.title: PowerUp Money raises $10 million
stories.summary: Wealthtech startup PowerUp Money has raised $10 million in a funding round led by Flourish Ventures. The company plans to use the fresh capital to develop its artificial intelligence-led wealth management solutions and expand its advisory offerings.

stories.title: Dispatch Network raises Rs 5 crore in pre-seed round
stories.summary: Last-mile delivery startup Dispatch Network has raised Rs 5 crore in a pre-seed round led by Antler India. The company will use the capital to expand its AI team and develop a Large Logistics Spatio-Temporal Model to improve delivery allocation.

stories.title: OneStack raises Rs 12.5 crore
stories.summary: Fintech infrastructure startup OneStack has raised Rs 12.5 crore from Shepherd's Hill, Pentathlon Ventures and AVNM Ventures. The company plans to use the capital to expand its digital banking solutions for cooperative banks and non-banking financial companies.

stories.title: Ottonomy raises Rs 40.6 crore in post-seed round
stories.summary: Autonomous delivery robot developer Ottonomy has raised Rs 40.6 crore in a post-seed round with participation from Enrission India Capital. The company will use the funds to accelerate its global expansion across healthcare and industrial automation.

stories.title: Obsess raises angel funding for fitness ecosystem
stories.summary: Fitness and sports technology startup Obsess has raised angel funding to develop a unified digital ecosystem for India. The company aims to integrate consumers, service providers and businesses across fitness, sports and wellness through a single platform. Financial details were not disclosed.

stories.title: Northwood Space raises $375 million Series C
stories.summary: Northwood Space has raised $375 million in a Series C round at a $2 billion valuation. The company manufactures modular antennas to connect satellites to Earth, aiming to solve the bottleneck caused by ground stations that take years to build.

stories.title: Trajectory raises $45 million at $300 million valuation
stories.summary: AI startup Trajectory has raised $45 million in a Sequoia-led Series A round. The company is building a platform that helps businesses train AI models through continuous feedback, without the need for specialised research teams.

stories.title: Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million Series B
stories.summary: Robotics company Tutor Intelligence has raised $75 million in a Series B round to collect data from real-world work environments. The company builds robots and foundation models, aiming to provide the physical data that the internet currently lacks.

stories.title: Journify raises $12 million Series A
stories.summary: Ad signal infrastructure startup Journify has raised $12 million in a Series A round led by Al Mada Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to expand into the US and Europe and further develop the AI capabilities behind its platform.

stories.title: Movin raises $7.6 million Series A
stories.summary: LiDAR-based AI company Movin has raised $7.6 million in a Series A round led by IMM Investment. The company plans to expand its motion capture business and build a research and development centre to strengthen its physical AI technology.

stories.title: Cosmoserve raises $6 million in seed funding
stories.summary: Spacetech startup Cosmoserve has raised $6 million in a seed round led by Rebright Partners. The company plans to use the capital to support tech demonstrations and fuel two upcoming missions, aiming for commercialisation by 2028.

stories.title: Mindmax raises £2.5 million
stories.summary: AI learning startup Mindmax has raised £2.5 million. The company aims to help users develop their cognitive abilities rather than outsource them to technology. The round includes backing from the co-founder of the defence tech decacorn Helsing.

stories.title: Northwood Space hits $2 billion valuation
stories.summary: Northwood Space has raised $375 million in a Series C round led by Andreessen Horowitz and DFJ Growth. The startup plans to add 400 jobs over the next three years as it expands its shared satellite ground network.

stories.title: Solgram raises over $1 million
stories.summary: Premium grocery startup Solgram has raised over $1 million in a pre-seed round led by DSG Consumer Partners and Saama Capital. The company plans to use the capital to strengthen its cold-chain infrastructure and expand across the National Capital Region.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital shuts London office in global restructure
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital is closing its London office and ending its Arc accelerator and Scouts programmes as part of a major operational reset. The firm, which recently raised $10 billion, is also merging its early and growth stage investing teams. The Sequoia of tomorrow looks smaller than today.

stories.title: Everstone AMC raises $179 million for mid-market fund
stories.summary: Everstone AMC has secured $179.3 million in the first close of its new private equity fund. The vehicle targets mid-market Indian companies, focusing on growth deals where it can exert control. The firm aims to build a platform of choice for domestic investors and family offices.

stories.title: Daksham Capital launches consumer-focused venture fund
stories.summary: Multi-family office group Daksham Capital has launched its maiden consumer-focused fund, Daksham Growth Ventures, with a target corpus of ₹300 crore. The fund secured ₹125 crore in its first close from family offices and high-net-worth individuals. It plans to back 15 startups with mid-sized cheques.

stories.title: Aavishkaar launches $263 million climate and fintech fund
stories.summary: Aavishkaar Foundation has launched a ₹2,500 crore venture fund to back 30 Indian startups over the next five years. The fund will focus on climate technology, energy transition, and fintech. The foundation has previously disbursed over ₹5,000 crore to roughly 100 startups across various sectors.

stories.title: Gaja Capital eyes ₹8,000 crore fundraising capacity
stories.summary: Gaja Alternative Asset Management says its current balance sheet can support ₹8,000 crore of fundraising at an 8.4 percent sponsor-commitment rate. The firm plans to launch two funds in the 2026-27 period, targeting a combined ₹4,000 crore. The firm remains focused on its next deployment cycle.

stories.title: Fireside Ventures partner Vinay Singh exits firm
stories.summary: Vinay Singh, co-founder and partner at consumer-focused venture firm Fireside Ventures, is leaving after a decade. His departure follows a trend of senior-level churn in India’s venture capital ecosystem, as partners increasingly depart to launch independent funds or pursue new opportunities outside their existing platforms.

stories.title: Champagne Fund launches to support Tennessee startups
stories.summary: The Champagne Fund has launched in Knoxville to provide networking and investment for women-led startups. The initiative aims to educate women on venture capital and back local Tennessee businesses. The fund operates in partnership with Market Square Ventures, which provides the necessary infrastructure for the vehicle.

stories.title: Ballistic Ventures seeks $490 million for cybersecurity
stories.summary: Cybersecurity-focused firm Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $490 million across two new funds. The San Francisco-based firm filed with the SEC to bolster its flagship and secondary vehicles. The raise comes as the industry faces heightened threats from hackers using artificial intelligence to accelerate attacks.

stories.title: Robin Capital closes second €15 million fund
stories.summary: Berlin-based Robin Capital has closed its second €15 million early-stage fund, bringing its total commitments to €30 million. The firm has made 51 investments to date, targeting intelligence, defense, and space exploration. It also manages three special purpose vehicles to back specific growth-stage robotics and technology companies.

stories.title: Razorpay receives SEBI approval for IPO
stories.summary: Razorpay has received regulatory approval from SEBI for its planned ₹6,500 crore initial public offering. The fintech company is targeting a valuation of $5 billion. The full details of the offering and the timeline for the market debut have not been disclosed in this report.

stories.title: Shiprocket returns to profit in second quarter
stories.summary: Ecommerce platform Shiprocket reported a consolidated net profit of ₹0.6 crore for the September quarter, compared to a loss of ₹20.3 crore a year ago. Operating revenue rose 35 percent to ₹674 crore. The company's revenue growth outpaced its total expenditure during the period.

stories.title: Nykaa profit triples as revenue climbs
stories.summary: Nykaa reported a 207 percent jump in consolidated net profit to ₹101 crore for the September quarter. Operating revenue rose 28 percent to ₹3,006 crore, driven by stronger beauty profitability and narrower fashion losses. Total expenses grew at a slower pace than the company's operating revenue.

stories.title: Lenskart reports 125 percent profit growth
stories.summary: Eyewear company Lenskart reported a consolidated net profit of ₹233 crore for the September quarter, a 125 percent increase from the year-ago period. Operating revenue rose 36 percent to ₹2,845 crore. The company's revenue growth outpaced the increase in its total expenses for the quarter.

stories.title: PhysicsWallah revenue and profit rise in second quarter
stories.summary: Edtech firm PhysicsWallah reported operational revenue of ₹1,242 crore for the second quarter, an 18 percent increase year-on-year. Net profit doubled to ₹142 crore, which the company attributed to digital scale and operating efficiencies. The firm saw record quarterly revenue driven by expanding student enrolments.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging returns to profitability
stories.summary: Defence tech company Tonbo Imaging swung to a net profit of ₹23.5 crore in the September quarter, following a loss in the previous period. Operating revenue jumped significantly to ₹183 crore. The company's revenue growth outpaced its rising expenses, marking a return to the black.

stories.title: Freshworks swings to $18 million profit
stories.summary: Nasdaq-listed Freshworks reported a net profit of $18.3 million for the third quarter, compared to a $4.7 million loss a year earlier. Revenue rose 14 percent to $245 million. The company reduced its operating expenses, including general and administrative costs and stock-based compensation, during the period.

stories.title: Amagi revenue grows as profit spikes
stories.summary: Amagi Media Labs reported a 27 percent revenue increase to ₹476 crore for the September quarter. Profit after tax rose nearly 30-fold to ₹75 crore. The company, which provides cloud-based solutions to broadcasters, also reported a 114 percent increase in adjusted EBITDA for the period.

stories.title: NLC India profit doubles as renewables IPO approved
stories.summary: NLC India reported a twofold increase in net profit to ₹1,381 crore for the September quarter. Revenue rose 13 percent to ₹4,732 crore, though EBITDA declined slightly. The company board has approved an offer for sale of 10 crore shares for its renewables arm's upcoming IPO.

stories.title: Canva cuts 22 percent of workforce
stories.summary: Canva will cut, relocate or change the roles of 1,271 employees, representing 22 percent of its staff. CEO Melanie Perkins cited a need to address slowing growth as the company navigates a structural reckoning. Success in the first chapter apparently does not guarantee success in the next.

stories.title: Canva lays off over 1,200 people amid slowing growth | TechCrunch
stories.summary: Design software maker Canva is cutting 22% of its staff, amounting to 1,271 people, amid a growth slowdown. The company’s co-founder and CEO, Melanie Perkins, in a note to employees said while Canva has scaled so far, it needs to change to address slowing growth.

stories.title: Indian startups launch offline AI models
stories.summary: Soket Labs and ZenteiQ AiTech have launched Dhīr and EKA-1, foundation models designed to function without internet connectivity. The startups claim the open-source models support multiple Indian languages and provide automation for defence and government sectors. The models are built to work where the internet does not.

stories.title: Sarvam and others join AI decision model race
stories.summary: Startups including ConvAI Innovations and Sthānika AI are developing models designed to make specific decisions rather than just answer questions. These tools aim to automate tasks like document review or query routing. The industry is betting that specialised models will perform better than general ones.

stories.title: Indian banks report AI agent errors
stories.summary: HDFC, Kotak and Axis banks have reported instances of AI agents making unauthorised offers and deleting records. No specific rules governing agent behaviour are currently in force, with a data law not expected until 2027. The agents are currently operating without a rulebook.

stories.title: CERT-In warns of AI-driven financial attacks
stories.summary: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team has warned of a threat actor dubbed CRAFTY FALCON. The agency says the entity uses machine intelligence to survey targets and invoke payment APIs at machine speed. The government body considers the threat to be immediate and continuing.

stories.title: Security flaws found in Tata Motors apps
stories.summary: CERT-In has identified high-severity vulnerabilities in Tata Motors iRA 2.0 and iRA.ev applications. The agency warns that these flaws could allow unauthorised access to vehicle services and user credentials. The vulnerabilities affect specific versions of the connected vehicle apps.

stories.title: Meta delays new business terms
stories.summary: Meta has postponed updated terms that would have allowed the company to scrape data from business accounts. Media companies and advocates had raised concerns that the rules would enable Meta to build competing services using their content. The rollout was originally scheduled for October 30.

research.title: A Feasibility Condition for Confidence-Gated Tiered LLM Inference
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Most such. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge's bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Anduin: A sybil-resistant agentic marketplace reputation system
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: As autonomous AI agents enter permissionless onchain markets, selecting new service providers remains a core challenge. Existing reputation systems depend on scarce resources like human curation, identity credentials, or voluntary reviews, while naive volume rankings are. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous software agents can act through tools, delegate work, and change their models or execution environments while earlier authorizations remain in flight. We present Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), an approach designed to be harness-independent, for maintaining. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Attributing Agent Failures to Their History Needs an Executed Counterfactual: Toward a Reporting Standard
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Published explanations of why long-horizon agents fail are commonly taxonomies labeled over completed trajectories: a judge reads a transcript and names the failure. We argue that a claim attributing an agent's behavior to its history should. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: BrainBind: Bridging Synchronized EEG and fMRI through Long-Form Naturalistic Video Representations
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-world vision is dynamic and scene-rich, while EEG and fMRI resolve it at complementary temporal and spatial scales. Most neural decoding systems, however, align one modality in isolation and mostly against static images or short clips. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
